comment: shknam.c stock_room(): the first shop door keeps the doormask that mklev.c dosdoor() wrote to rm.flags. A debug Healer level-teleports to Dlvl 3, whose armor shop has a closed first door at <69,7>, and maps the level with ^F (detect.c do_mapping), which shows the door closed (+). Before the fix stock_room() read an empty doormask copy and opened the door. The seed was found with scripts/scan-port.mjs scanSeeds() over seeds 830001-830200 (Dlvl 3 shop with a closed or locked first door; 30 of 200 kept) and was not taken from a recorded session.
